testCase.name: [dev] S16 Trash icon opens an app-style pop-up that explains the delete; Cancel keeps the patient

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B24 · P1 · 已知

删除：医院用的是浏览器自带的确认框，删除后没有「已删除」提示；养老院根本没法删除住户

票：TFA-92579 AC7 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S17, OAT-06/S22

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S16 「垃圾桶图标打开一个 app 风格的弹窗，说明删除会怎样；Cancel 保留病人」 Trash icon opens an app-style pop-up that explains the delete; Cancel keeps the patient

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK.（TFA-92579 AC 7）
  • T3 Delete asks for confirmation once; there is no bulk delete in V1.（TFA-92579 AC 2；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Standard fixture

When Nursing Home first: tap the trash icon on the resident's card, read the pop-up, press Cancel; then the same on the Hospital card

Then An in-app pop-up (not the browser's native confirm) names the patient, says what deleting does, offers Cancel and OK; after Cancel the card is still there

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: pop-up snapshot mustContain 'button "Cancel"' and 'button "OK"' and mustNotContain 'native dialog:' (the marker the agent writes when a browser dialog opens); pop-up text file (only the pop-up's own text, so the card behind it cannot satisfy the check) mustContain the name and 'delete'; after-cancel checkpoint mustContain 'Open chart for <name>'. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U09；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa

删除医院病人时弹出的是浏览器自带的确认框，不是 app 风格、带 Cancel/OK 的弹窗；养老院卡片上根本没有垃圾桶。点 Cancel 后病人还在（这部分正常）。

Deleting a Hospital patient opens the browser's own confirm box instead of an app-style pop-up with Cancel/OK, and Nursing Home cards have no trash icon at all; Cancel does keep the patient.

依据：dev U09 (ledger #9). Already in dev report §2 #7 (TFA-92579 AC 7). Q6 (whether Nursing Home residents should be deletable from the card) is still open. Q8: ACs 2/4/7/8 were added on 10-01 and no PR covers them.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
